identity.face_index: zero-based raw OCCT TopExp traversal order used by the audited generator; accepted only when annotation ids are canonical and contiguous, bottom covers the same ids, imported BRep is valid and build123d faces are IsSame position-by-position with an independent raw traversal

policy.development: Buckets 0 through 499 are open development and validation evidence. Malformed selected models are recorded and skipped. Counts are diagnostic, not a definition, and corpus labels never change predicates or reconciliation.
policy.holdout: Buckets 500 through 999 remain sealed for one epic or release-candidate final evaluation. Repository chronology records no earlier unselected scan of this half; this is an attestation about recorded runs, not a claim that external access was impossible. Generic development access cannot inspect them.
policy.named_allocations: Per-family selectors and reveal tokens are retired. Earlier selections remain historical chronology only. Their models now follow the broad 0 through 499 development policy and may be rerun as development evidence, never as a reused named draw. Old holdout buckets 10 through 19 and unrevealed named buckets 34 and 35 are now part of open development; previously accessed buckets are not newly independent evidence. No named allocation may be created under schema version 2.
policy.redistribution: The Kaggle dataset and generator repository report MIT, but the full dataset remains external. No MFTRCAD model is vendored by this manifest.
